title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
blurb: Trained continuous normalising flows without simulation by regressing a velocity field onto per-sample target velocities along simple paths from noise to data.
intro: Pick a path from each noise sample to a data sample, such as a straight line, and its velocity is known in closed form. Regressing a network onto those conditional velocities learns a field whose ODE moves the whole noise distribution onto the data. Sampling integrates that ODE with a standard solver. The steps build the flow-matching loss, conversions between prediction targets and an ODE sampler; the capstone trains a small velocity model and integrates it with Euler or midpoint steps.
